description: Archive an activity type or group the user no longer uses, or bring an archived one back (restore=true). Only when the user asks for it. Archived types leave the type lists and cannot be started or logged; their history is kept and still counts in reports. Archiving a group leaves the types inside it as they are. list_activity_types with include_archived=true shows the archived ones.

restore.description: Bring an archived type back instead of archiving (default false)

type.description: Name of the type or group, e.g. "Guitar"

type_id.description: Exact id from list_activity_types, instead of type (internal — never show ids to the user)

name: archive_activity_type
title: Archive or restore activity type
